about: Census of the consumers whose FITS read buoy observations (#1199 served-wave-skill-v1 section 1a: 'Any buoy whose observations have fitted or calibrated anything that serves or is being built'). Input to the version 2 buoy list's fit_used / fit_used_by tags (scripts/served_wave_verify_freeze_buoys.py tag). Ids are the consumer's whole set; the tag step intersects them with the list.

skill_ledger_fits.source: forecast_skill.py ledgers every buoy mapped to a spot; the set is surf_spots.noaa_buoy_id (distinct, non-empty), read 2026-11-23 from the production database by one SELECT (60 ids).
skill_ledger_fits.what: The skill ledger's fitted shadows, all trained on scored rows at every mapped buoy: the debiased and inverse-MSE weighted consensus (services/weather_pipeline/skill_consensus.py), the pooled linear MOS and the OCF per-lead / per-coast / rolling biases (skill_ocf.py), and the per-region rolling bias correction being built (SOTA plan item 8, log 2026-11-15-senior-research-lead-sota-plan.md).

wave_emos_l1.what: L1 probabilistic offshore Hs, NGR/EMOS fitted per lead bin by minimum CRPS on a rolling 90-day window (backend/scripts/wave_emos_core.py, gate wave_l1_score.py).

method: Every listed station id was searched (word-bounded) in every tracked backend and .github file on origin/dev 600d60369 outside this lane and its tests; each hit file was read and classed FIT (its output is a fitted or calibrated parameter set that serves or is being built) or NOT A FIT (scores, validates, archives or names a station). Database-held station sets were read where the consumer takes them from the database.

not_a_fit.backend/scripts/partition_truth/*: scores GFS-Wave partitions against buoy spectra; fits nothing
not_a_fit.backend/services/weather_pipeline/buoy_c: residual report; 'it never changes a served rating' (its docstring); the fitted consumers of the ledger it feeds are listed above
not_a_fit.backend/services/weather_pipeline/nwps_n: NWPS comparison arm and archive of NOAA model output at buoy points (model spectra, not buoy observations)
not_a_fit.backend/services/weather_pipeline/pilot_: a comment naming 46206 in a region note
not_a_fit.backend/services/weather_pipeline/skill_: an independent same-model REFERENCE lane (NOAA's own GFS-Wave point bulletins), not a fit

open.why_open: its station set is weather-products/calibration/emos/stations.json, a private bucket object this lane's session was not permitted to read on 2026-11-23. NDBC buoys with anemometers may be in it. Until it is read, a listed buoy in it is NOT tagged; whoever freezes #1199's lists reads it and adds the consumer here (a new census, a new list version).
